text:
leah: FYI running the quickstart with the new JS SDK exposes a repeating pattern: steady throughput, then ~2s freeze, then a burst of requests. repro: ./loadgen --clients=35 --pages=10 --mix search:heavy,embed:heavy

tom: which sampleapp and sdk version?

leah: sampleapp@main + js-sdk@0.11.2. minimal logs:
```
WARN limiter: queued (scope=global) inflight=180
DEBUG paginator: blocked waiting for permit page=5 cursor=abc123
INFO auth: refresh requested by caller A
INFO retry: attempt=1 immediate_requeue=true
ERROR api: 403 token expired
```

alex: immediate_requeue=true looks like our retry path is bypassing the client limiter again. If refresh takes a bit, everything piles up then all retries fire.

irene: Agree. Also the paginator holds the page cursor while waiting for permit which causes head-of-line blocking. If embed calls hog permits, search paginators freeze.

leah: Short-term workaround: run sampleapp with CLIENT_PER_ROUTE=true so each logical route has its own client and limiter. That reduces cross-route stealing. But need a proper fix.

tom: Proposed fixes:
- add limiter.scope config: global|client|route (default global for compat)
- ensure all retry and auth refresh paths call limiter.acquire() (no bypass flag)
- implement singleflight token refresh in js-sdk auth module so concurrent refreshes dedupe
- change paginator to PREFETCH_NEXT_PAGE=true behavior: return current results while fetching next token async

alex: For singleflight impl: Map<key,Promise>. On start set promise, others await it, delete on success/fail. Add TTL slightly less than token TTL to avoid refresh storms. Unit test must simulate concurrent callers.

irene: On rollout, gate behind feature flag and add telemetry: metric client.limiter.scope and metric auth.refresh.concurrent_count. We should also emit a "paginator.hold_time_ms" histogram to detect regressions.

leah: I'll open a draft PR with three commits: limiter scope change, auth singleflight, sampleapp prefetch toggle + docs. Will include repro harness and load test in devex/integration.

tom: I'll own the limiter change and tests. Alex take auth singleflight. Irene update sampleapp and telemetry.

ops-bot: Please file issue area/devex and add labels test/e2e and priority/medium.

alex: One more thought: make retry backoff include jitter and a small randomized delay even after refresh success to avoid synchronized retries across clients.

leah: Good call. I'll add jitter to retry backoff in the PR. Targeting draft by EOD.
